inherited.M01: Vocalized (open-vocal-tract) production during data collection, as in the ultrasound-to-speech lineage (Csapó et al. 2017; Gosztolya et al. 2019); no silent-articulation condition.
inherited.M03: The single-participant model-selection setup follows the personalized ultrasound-formant baseline lineage represented by Juanpere and Csapó [11]; no calibration or adaptation method is added.
inherited.M04: The use-time task follows the ultrasound-to-formant baseline lineage of Juanpere and Csapó [11]; this paper does not introduce a distinct silent or non-vocal user action.
inherited.M05: Ultrasound tongue imaging with synchronized acoustic recording follows the ultrasound-to-formant lineage represented by Juanpere and Csapó [11]; the specific ALOKA and microphone hardware are implementation choices.
inherited.M07: Continuous formant regression and synthesis follow the prior ultrasound-to-formant and Klatt-synthesis lineage [11, 12]; no use-time lexicon or language model is introduced.
inherited.M08: The formant-to-speech stage uses the joint parallel-cascaded Klatt synthesis approach cited in [12], rather than a new synthesis method.
inherited.M09: The offline research pipeline follows the prior ultrasound-to-formant lineage [11] and adds no presentation, confirmation, or commit interface.
inherited.M10: The offline research pipeline follows the prior ultrasound-to-formant lineage [11] and adds no user correction, re-entry, or action-adjustment mechanism.
inherited.M11: The LPC-derived f1/f2 acoustic reference construction follows the ultrasound-to-formant regression lineage represented by Juanpere and Csapó [11]; no independently validated reference procedure is added.
inherited.M02: Paired synchronized audio supplies the regression targets (LPC-derived f1/f2), the standard paired-audio supervision of articulatory-to-acoustic mapping; no auxiliary or speech-latent loss.
inherited.M13: Laboratory ultrasound system with head stabilization; no wearability, latency or clinical evaluation, as in most ultrasound SSI studies.

topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies whose ledger lists ultrasound imaging as input and speech synthesis, a vocoder or an acoustic/formant output, and classify by full-text pattern (whole text, related-work mentions included, so counts are upper bounds) the acoustic representation the network is trained to predict: vocoder spectral parameters (MGC-LSP, mel-cepstrum, MFCC), mel-spectrogram, formant frequencies. Boundary: reviews and corpus papers count as pattern matches; a hit on 'formant' in related work or as an analysis feature is not a formant target unless the snippet shows prediction; versions count once by key.
topics.metric: speech-output quality of the synthesized signal (MCD, listening score, ASR WER)

topics.inclusion_rule: Same population as M06 ultrasound-to-speech-acoustic-target; classify by full-text pattern whether the synthesized speech itself is evaluated: listening test (MUSHRA, MOS, subjective test), mel-cepstral distortion, or an intelligibility measure (STOI, WER). Boundary: related-work mentions count (upper bound); evaluation of intermediate parameters only (formant R2, spectral-parameter correlation) does not count as speech-output evaluation.
